gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads like marker on paper, bulky and plain sans in every letter. Starborn floats above it with dreamy gaps between its letters, while the body does the steady, no-fuss work of staying legible.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-tiktok-sans: Dreamy spacing defines Starborn, with dark lowercase running through each line. TikTok Sans follows with a tall x-height and an open c, so a modest size suits the heading's wide gaps.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-ubuntu-sans: Starborn drifts along in ethereal space and heavy dark lowercase, while Ubuntu Sans has big round eyes and tubular strokes. Long paragraphs run smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws every line like it used a ruler. Starborn is best at dreamy, spaced-out display work, whereas the body keeps horizontals as heavy as its verticals and fills the line with tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-steelfish-fs-karma: Tall, narrow lowercase and a thick-only outline mark Steelfish. Karma, a classic serif, keeps its modulation moderate and its terminals clear of the stem, so paragraphs of it move along without a snag.
gen-dafont-steelfish-fs-paquito: Steelfish draws its outline like a drafting pen with one constant nib width, tall and tight. Paquito, a text serif, sits close between x-height and caps, which makes it better for brief copy.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-abeezee: Structural and striking, Stencilia opens its curves wide at the terminals. And ABeeZee, a sans with a high mean line and no thick-thin swing, glows like neon tubing beneath it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads like tracing a single thick thread, with cupped round letters and tall lowercase. Stencilia, a striking display face with spacious curve gaps, then adds structure above it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-alexandria: Alexandria stands tall, with wide open c terminals and short stems above and below the body of each letter. Stencilia's structural headings sit above a sans that keeps going comfortably.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-amiko: Stencilia is structural and striking, leaving spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a compact distance up to the ascender line. Amiko's outward-pointing terminals are the pair's sharpest contrast.
